query: SELECT cc.nome, SUM(lc.valor) as total FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 30001 AND cc.nome LIKE '%Indiret%' GROUP BY cc.nome
